data.description:
## Context

Placeholder epic. Extension of 4911-c7ba (reviewer rubric coverage registry, level a) to level b: replay corpus.

Where 4911-c7ba ships the registry + audit + fix-bug tagging + retro review, this epic adds mechanical validation: a fixture set of one minimal known-bad diff per registered bug class, with a test that runs the relevant reviewer prompt against each fixture and asserts a finding tagged with the expected rubric source.

Effect: reviewer prompt edits cannot silently regress coverage for a known class — the corpus enforces it.

## Prerequisites

- 4911-c7ba (level a) must ship first so the registry exists to drive fixture organization.

## Tentative scope

- One known-bad diff fixture per bug class registered in the coverage registry.
- Reviewer-replay harness (invokes reviewer delta prompt against fixture, asserts rubric-source-tagged finding).
- CI integration so corpus runs on reviewer prompt changes.
- Process: how new registry entries get a paired fixture before merging.

## Out of scope

- Closed-loop automation (level c) — separate follow-on.

## Not yet brainstormed

This is a placeholder. Full brainstorm pending 4911-c7ba completion.
data.title: Reviewer rubric replay corpus (level-b extension of 4911-c7ba)
